title: Vice President - Technology
jobDescription:
Job Summary
We are looking for a seasoned Technology Leader with a strong foundation in engineering delivery, solutioning and technology leadership, not purely delivery operations. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across modern technology landscapes, strong platform thinking and a proven track record of driving multiple concurrent complex programs across accounts while engaging with senior stakeholders.   • Experience in leading globally distributed engineering teams
  • Strong experience in engineering-led delivery(not delivery operations management)
  • Deep understanding of IT services ecosystem, engagement models, and client delivery frameworks
  • Ability to partner effectively with sales, practice and account delivery teams
  • Ability to deliver engagements in partnership with client/multi-vendor PODs
  • Ability to advise, influence and partner (and be accountable to) with MD/ CXO level senior stakeholders on technology strategy and execution
  • Strong expertise in leading teams delivering initiatives in some or more of:
    • Full-stack applications
    • Services/API based solutions

    • Data Analytics / Data Engineering
    • AI / ML and emerging technologies
    • Modernization
  • Solid grounding in architecture, microservices, and scalable system design
  • Experience in driving scope, estimation, execution approach and dependency management aligned with problem and tech context
  • Experience in leading multiple small mid sized, distributed teams, programs and global delivery programs across geographies, client and other vendor teams
  • Strong business outcome orientation
